messages:
maya: Quick idea — add a lightweight "resident-set estimator" plus a client hint API so callers can tell the runtime expected token reuse pattern. Could reduce offloads for scoring workloads.

liam: Can you sketch the hint shape? is it per-request or per-route?

maya: Per-request allowed, per-route default. Minimal fields: reuse_type=(prefix|random|repeat), expected_reuse_window=int_tokens, critical=(true|false).

oliver: Hmm. How does this avoid abusive clients tricking the runtime into hoarding VRAM? DoS risk.

maya: Good point. We'll cap prefetch budget per route+tenant and expose backpressure metrics. Also make hints advisory — runtime can ignore or downgrade.

sophia: Example header? plz.

maya: Example curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Usage-Hint: reuse=prefix;expected_tokens=1024;critical=false" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","prompt":"..."}'
```

maya: Internally estimator keeps a lightweight LRU-ish sketch of resident KV pages, reports a resident_set_estimate metric per route. Prefetch tries to pin only if estimate+expected_reuse <= budget.

liam: What about multi-model ensembles where one request hits many models? Need atomicity for prefetchs to avoid partial pins.

oliver: Could do a two-phase: reserve budget tokens, then prefetch best-effort. If reservation fails, fall back to normal path.

sophia: Metrics to watch: rs_estimate_bytes, hint_prefetch_attempts, hint_prefetch_success, hint_hit_ratio. Also evictions_triggered_by_hint.

runtime-bot: [info] prefetch-controller: reservation accepted (route=score-service tenant=acme) trace=abc123

evictd-bot: [event] evict: freed 1.2GB from device0 to host due to pressure (cause=spill_for_prefetch)

maya: Tradeoffs:
- Pros: reduce tail latency for scoring by avoiding hot prefix offloads
- Cons: complexity, fairness, potential for increased overall GPU memory usage

liam: Also: need CLI and console UX to surface per-route budgets and recent hint stats.

maya: Action items:
- I'll draft a short RFC with API spec + reservation semantics (EOW)
- Sophia will prototype Prometheus metrics + dashboards
- Oliver will review DoS mitigation section

oliver: +1. Also add an opt-in gate for Dedicated vs Hosted tiers (different caps).

sophia: I'll add a small sim harness to replay scoring traces and measure hit ratio.

liam: Curious whether this should be an Optimize feature or runtime core. My vote: runtime core (but behind a feature flag).

maya: Agreed. Feature-flagged runtime rollout.

runtime-bot: [note] created issue RW-8913: "prefetch-hint-api RFC" assigned=maya

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC draft in #eng-runtime when ready. :tada:
